title: Bottom of the Ninth, Game 6
setup: Bottom of the ninth in Game 6 of the 1985 World Series. The Cardinals lead the Royals 1-0. Kansas City pinch hitter Jorge Orta squibs a grounder toward first base, and the play at the bag is close.
question: What does first base umpire Don Denkinger call?
options: Out. The Cardinals keep the 1-0 lead.
Nothing yet. The umpires huddle to confirm the call.
ruling: Denkinger called Orta safe, saying he looked down and saw Orta's foot on the bag. The article describing the play says Orta was clearly out by a half-step. The Royals scored twice in the inning to win 2-1, and they won Game 7 11-0.
rulebookNote: The source says Denkinger later wished the replay rule had been in place that night so the call could have been made correctly. No replay review was used.
